You could see it.''"

You rail it here at night, I got no sympathy.|Two prisoners discuss Veemoss's death|audio=VeemossSlipping.flac|}} '''Veemoss''' was a [[human]] who was [[Prisoner|imprisoned]] by the [[Galactic Empire]] on the [[moon]] [[Narkina 5]]. In the [[Narkina 5 Imperial Prison Complex|prison]], his unit of prisoners constructed complex Imperial machinery by [[Standard day|day]] and at night slept in [[Prison|cells]] surrounded by electrified flooring. In [[5 BBY]], Veemoss was [[Death|killed]] by the electrified flooring outside his cell, causing his fellow inmates in [[Unit Five-Two-D]] to complain about the impact that his death would have. ==Biography== {{Dialogue|Prisoner 1|Aw, man.|Prisoner 2|Well we'll be smellin' him all night.|Prisoner 3|Here? He rails it here?|attr=Three prisoners discuss Veemoss's death|audio=VeemossSmelling.flac|src=}} Veemoss was a [[human]] who, by [[5 BBY]], had been [[Prisoner|imprisoned]] in an [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Narkina 5 Imperial Prison Complex|prison complex]] on the [[moon]]{{Andor|Narkina 5 (episode)}} {{AD|Disney+}} [[Narkina 5]]. He was assigned to [[table three]] of [[Unit Five-Two-D]], the dayshift of room two on [[Level 5 (Narkina 5)|Level 5]] of the [[prison]]. During their twelve-[[Standard hour|hour]] shifts, the prisoners constructed [[EP-N5 fastener]]s,''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' a type of complex Imperial machinery{{Databank|ham|Ham}} that would eventually be used as parts for the Imperial [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superlaser]].{{Andor|Rix Road (episode)}} Once the shift was over, they returned to their living quarters, where the floor outside each prisoner's open cell in the cell block was [[Death|lethally]] electrified at [[Standard day|night]]. After the cell block lights had been turned off one night in that [[Standard year|year]], Veemoss was killed by the electrified floors after having stood perched at the edge of his cell while breathing heavily and staring at the "hot" floor. His yell as he perished alerted many of the other prisoners in the cell block, who shouted to each other to establish who had died. [[File:VeemossDeath.png|thumb|right|300px|Veemoss's death on the cellblock floor angered some of the other inmates in the Narkina 5 prison.]] Unsure if he had fallen or purposefully jumped, one prisoner claimed that Veemoss had clearly been slipping recently, but several others were angered by Veemoss's death due to the smell that his body would leave in the block and the fact that table three would become shorthanded. The prison system then detected the disruption of the grid caused by Veemoss's death, and the Imperials ordered the other prisoners back to their beds. On the next day, table three fell behind on its production numbers until a new prisoner was brought in to replace Veemoss.{{Andor|Nobody's Listening!}} ==Personality and traits== {{Dialogue|Prisoner 1|Veemoss! Table three, the tall one.|Prisoner 2|He fell!|Prisoner 3|Or jumped.|attr=Three prisoners discuss Veemoss's death|audio=VeemossTable3.flac|src=}} Veemoss was a lanky individual who was considered to be tall by his fellow prisoners. At the [[time]] of his death, he was bald. ==Equipment== While imprisoned on Narkina 5, Veemoss wore a paper-thin white-and-orange [[Clothing|prison uniform]] and no footwear. ==Behind the scenes== Portrayed by an uncredited actor, Veemoss appeared in "[[Narkina 5 (episode)|Narkina 5]]," the eighth episode of the live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]''{{'s}} [[Andor Season 1|first season]], which was aired on [[October 26]], [[2022]].{{Twitter|starwars|status/1557442379975573504|[[Star Wars]]|date=2022-8-10|quote=This is what revolution looks like. Watch #Andor, a Star Wars Original Series, streaming only on @DisneyPlus September 21.|archivedate=20220810191942}} The Narkina 5 prison sequences were the final scenes shot for the first season of ''Andor''{{YouTube|video=CZq4wKUM410|text=Were the Prison Episodes TOO Dark for Star Wars?|channel=@StarWarsExplained|name=Star Wars Explained|date=2022-11-15|quote=The prison episodes of Star Wars Andor were very bleak for a Star Wars story. I got the chance to ask the writer of the arc about the balance between darkness and hope. Here is what he had to say.}} and were filmed at [[Pinewood Studios]] over a period of seven weeks around [[August]].{{SWYouTube|_qP3CnChXgk|Andor Season 1 with Tony Gilroy LIVE | Season 2 Coming April 22 on Disney+}} ==Appearances== *{{Andor|Narkina 5 (episode)}} {{1st}} ==Notes and references== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Veemoss}} {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Veemoss |fr=Veemoss |ja=ヴィーモス |ka=ვიმოსი |nl=Veemoss |pl=Veemoss }} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Narkina 5 Imperial Prison Complex prisoners]]
